title: Update your business details
blurb: Set the business name, email, phone and website customers see.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Business Profile
steps.body: Click **Business Profile** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Check your names
steps.body: Under **General Information**, fill in **Friendly Business Name** (what customers know you as) and **Legal Business Name** (as registered with the Companies Office).

steps.title: Add contact details
steps.body: Enter your **Business Email**, **Business Phone** and **Business Website**. Use an email you check often, as some notices go there.

steps.title: Set your currency
steps.body: Set **Business Currency** to NZD so invoices, products and reports show New Zealand dollars.
steps.tip: Change currency before you create products or invoices, not after.
